heading: Research existing work and cite sources
reason: Literature ledger with 18 sources (S01-S18), each with URL, access date, and a read-depth note. S08 is verified from the proceedings; S09, S10, S15, S17 and S18 are abstract-level or search-summary reads, flagged in the interpretation (sections 2 and 8). Sources were re-checked against the interpretation's citations in this phase.

heading: Scientific mindset and role models
reason: The question, hypotheses, alternatives, and falsification rule were registered before results. The interpretation separates confirmatory outcomes (C1, C2) from exploratory ones (E1-E10) and records the unobserved prediction P3 (sections 4-6), following the scientific method loop in the harness contract.

heading: Experimental design and statistical rigor
reason: Preregistered primary metric, paired bootstrap with a fixed seed, per-seed effects with SD, controls (shuffled-label, class-prior), baselines (logistic), and an explicit confirmatory (C1, C2) versus exploratory (E1-E10) label on every claim. Power is audited in E6 (mde_audit.json). Limitations are stated per claim and in interpretation section 8. Note: the fixture labels the sensitivity, shuffled-label, logistic and class-prior records exploratory, so the registered prediction checks on those arms are reported as E10 with that caveat, and only P7 and P8 are confirmatory (C2).

heading: Grounding and technical correctness
reason: The decoupled-decay update is grounded in the installed torch source (S04) and checked against the weight-level analysis (E5, exploratory), which found a measured shrink about half the pure-decay prediction; the discrepancy is reported, not resolved. Accuracy is recomputed from stored predictions for every record (E4, exploratory post-hoc audit). The bootstrap is grounded in S17 and S18 (search-summary reads). Code audit (E9) found test features in eval-mode forward passes, disclosed in the interpretation. `study.py check` and the 13-test pytest suite were re-run in this phase and pass (research/analysis_checks.log, L12).

heading: Principles
reason: This phase wrote no implementation. The simplest-implementation principle applied to the fixture and the core phase, not to the analysis phase.

heading: Code structure and quality
reason: This phase added one single-purpose audit script, research/mde_audit.py (L11), which recomputes the minimum detectable effect. It is not part of the fixture and changes no shared code. Earlier analysis scripts in cycles/001/scripts/ were not modified.

heading: Claims, evidence and writing style
reason: Each claim has an analysis_kind (confirmatory for C1 and C2, exploratory for E1-E10), evidence IDs that resolve to results/*.json or research/evidence.json, and limitations. The interpretation uses evidence IDs and artifact paths and contains no typed empirical scores.

heading: Paper
reason: Paper generation is owned by the controller in the publish phase. The interpretation supplies the scientific content it needs.

heading: README.md and paper
reason: Eval tables and visualizations are generated by the controller from result files. README and paper are updated in the publish phase, so this phase makes no changes to them.

heading: Experiment reports
reason: One card per experiment record and one summary report exist from the experiments and pilot phases. The summary includes the method, registration chain, failures, and learnings. This phase reads them and does not rewrite them.

heading: Visualization
reason: Figures are generated by the controller in the publish phase. Figures from earlier phases are in cycles/001/figures/. No figure was produced or edited in this phase.

heading: README.md
reason: The README is updated in the publish phase, so this phase makes no changes to it.

heading: Docs
reason: The reproduction doc (cycles/001/docs/reproduction.md) was written in the core phase. This phase did not change the reproduction steps, so no update is needed here.

heading: Order of work
reason: The preregistration commit (287f40bd) precedes any result. Core and pilot were published before comparisons ran. The pilot was run before the comparison arms, as the protocol requires.

heading: Logging and comments
reason: Run logs carry UTC millisecond timestamps and record each training epoch and each saved record. Logs from earlier attempts are preserved, not overwritten.

heading: Testing, debugging and code review
reason: In this analysis phase the 13-test pytest suite and `study.py check` were re-run and both pass (research/analysis_checks.log, L12). The from-scratch rerun and independent record verification from the experiments phase are preserved (L04, L05).

heading: Git, GitHub and Hugging Face
reason: Commits, branches, pull requests, and uploads are owned by the harness controller. This phase did not run any git or upload action.

heading: Environment and project setup
reason: All commands in this phase ran with the project-local interpreter (.venv under the project root). The project root pyproject.toml is present.

heading: Machine, permissions and tools
reason: This phase used only files inside cycles/001 and the project-local interpreter. It did not inspect sibling projects. The GPU was used for the earlier MLP training runs (device cuda in the logs).

heading: README.md ocs, AGENTS.md, docs, results, paper, experiments, reports, experiment files, paper, HuggingFace card
reason: Documentation and model-card regeneration is owned by the publish phase. The interpretation and claims files are the phase outputs for this step.

heading: Final checks
reason: The final check of the full plan belongs to the publish phase. This phase covered the analysis deliverables and their checks.

heading: Attribution and visual debugging
reason: The AI statement and author attribution belong in the paper, which is generated in the publish phase. No paper text was written in this phase.
